t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the different coloured hats match up to the colour of the baskets, you should pay attention and select a different colour when the amount of mushrooms you receive starts to get lower.

vb_textbox.text: i will be completely honest, i think it is at random the amount of mushrooms you receive.. i tried matching hats, colour of the gnome outfit etc to the baskets but it just seemed random the whole time. my advice is to just go for it alternating your selection every couple of rounds. i really cant lie and say it the hats to the baskets because for me i did not notice a difference, good luck.
